changelog:
* **chore: update major version to v1.0.0** (0598cd6)
  - Updated versionName to 1.0.0 and versionCode to 2 in app build config.
  - Updated release manifest and OTA metadata to v1.0.0.6 in version.json.
  - Updated fallback version string in SettingsScreen and bot script.
* **feat: make settings cards collapsible** (ecaf3ec)
  - Make App Theme, Language, and Homepage Notes cards collapsible to save vertical screen space.
  - Display current setting selection summaries on collapsed headers.
  - Animate expansion state using AnimatedVisibility.
* **fix: restore functionality & backup settings** (a629725)
  - Fix restore logic to import calculation history into database instead of overwriting draft sheet.
  - Include full app preferences (theme, language, disabled denominations) in backup and restore JSON data.
  - Show restore warning dialog ("Restoring outdated/old data might corrupt or overwrite your present data.") when backup file is selected.
  - Re-sequence restored history items in chronological order to maintain proper serial numbering ("Sheet #1", "Sheet #2", etc.).
* **fix: dynamic about version info** (7748478)
  - Query app package info dynamically in Settings screen.
  - Format version digits into Bangla when Bangla language is set.
* **fix: apply Tiro Bangla font globally** (71e8803)
  - Apply TiroBanglaFontFamily across all 15 Material 3 typography styles.
  - Map Normal, Medium, SemiBold, and Bold weights to tiro_bangla font.
  - Fallback to ResourcesCompat and assets for PDF report font resolution.
* **feat: support immediate Bangla mode** (403beeb)
  - Apply complete Bangla localization across all app screens, dialogs, components, and reports when Bangla is selected.
  - Recalculate calculator state immediately on language setting change.
  - Use full Bangla month names in date formatting across history and exported reports.
* **feat: add splash screen image** (e7ea579)
  - Add androidx.core:core-splashscreen dependency for Android splash API support.
  - Set splash theme and logo using assets/icon.png with centered 1:1 scaling.
  - Rename app title in README.md to Cash Figure App.
* **style: simplify PDF report header** (98bd7bd)
  - Simplified the title header text to Cash Report.
  - Updated the footer text to Generated by Cash Figure App.
* **feat: require delete confirmation** (2e2e884)
  - Add confirmation dialog before deleting calculation entries from history.
  - Update HistoryViewModel state to handle delete dialog visibility.
* **fix: reset sheet numbering on data wipe** (f3cc18f)
  - Use count-based naming (Sheet #N) instead of DB auto-increment ID.
  - Add getHistorySheetCount() DAO query for sequential numbering.
  - Reset sqlite_sequence on resetAllData() so IDs restart from 1.
  - Simplify toDomainModel() display name to use stored name directly.
* **fix: Bangla text encoding in exports** (ef3e88c)
  - Add UTF-8 BOM to CSV export for Bangla mode.
  - Add UTF-8 BOM to TXT export for Bangla mode.
  - BOM ensures spreadsheet apps and text editors
    correctly interpret Bangla Unicode characters.
* **style: Clean up settings labels** (1f6b4b3)
  - Remove duplicate Bengali text from Language section heading.
  - Remove redundant (Bangla) from বাংলা option label.
* **fix: Hide zero amount in words label** (f8c1b93)
  - Hide the amount-in-words text in DashboardCard when totalPieces is 0.
  - Avoids showing redundant Zero Taka label on empty state.
* **feat: add grand total in breakdown** (e70732f)
  - Show sum of all active denomination totals at the bottom of the Cash Breakdown section.
  - Separated by a thicker divider for visual distinction.
  - Grand total value highlighted with primary color and bold styling.
* **feat: add clear row confirmation** (e677d8f)
  - Add confirmation dialog before clearing individual denomination row via cross icon.
  - Track pending denomination with nullable state instead of clearing immediately.
  - Show denomination label in dialog with Bangla/English support.
  - Match existing Clear All dialog pattern for consistent UX.
* **fix: Prevent duplicate toast stacking** (9a94c87)
  - Add activeToast reference to cancel previous toast before showing new one.
  - Add 500ms debounce on Save button click to ignore rapid repeated taps.
  - Apply toast deduplication to back-to-exit handler for consistency.
* **fix: strip TEST section from changelog** (a43f39f)
  - Filter TEST blocks and separator lines from commit body in changelog generation.
  - Clean existing version.json changelog entries to remove TEST sections.
